title: Conversation overview
caption: 15,883 packets between 10.251.96.4 and 10.251.96.5; this is all observed traffic between this pair, not a scan-only count.

title: TCP port scan
caption: Rapid SYN probes to multiple destination ports. Frames 133, 134 and 137 show SYN, SYN/ACK and RST for port 80, consistent with a half-open SYN scan.

title: Transition to HTTP
caption: A completed TCP handshake is followed by GET /, GET /favicon.ico and GET /login.php.

title: HTTP service response
caption: The server returns a web page and advertises Apache/2.4.29 (Ubuntu). The banner is a server claim, not independent version verification.

title: POST request overview
caption: POST activity includes two different address pairs. The displayed total of 151 is filter-wide, not 151 login attempts or 151 SQL injection requests.

title: SQL injection testing
caption: A request contains SQL-oriented test strings and a sqlmap/1.4.7#stable User-Agent. A database connection error is visible; successful SQL injection is not established.

title: PHP web shell upload
caption: POST /upload.php carries dbfunctions.php. Its PHP source reads cmd from the request and passes it to system().

title: Application confirms upload
caption: The response explicitly states that dbfunctions.php has been uploaded; a subsequent GET requests /uploads/.

title: Uploaded file appears in directory listing
caption: The /uploads/ index lists dbfunctions.php. This supports file presence; the later command outputs establish execution.

title: Command execution confirmed
caption: The id command returns uid=33(www-data), gid=33(www-data), groups=33(www-data).

title: Execution identity corroborated
caption: The whoami command returns www-data, corroborating the earlier identity result.

title: Reverse-shell request
caption: A Python command requests a TCP callback to 10.251.96.4:4422 and redirects a shell through the socket. This screenshot alone shows the request, not the connection endpoints of stream 1277.

title: Interactive shell exchange
caption: Two-way shell interaction shows www-data@bob-appserver, whoami output and directory navigation. This demonstrates an interactive shell; correlation with the previous request is strongly supported by sequence and context.

title: Filesystem discovery
caption: Root-directory entries and permissions are listed. Root-owned files in the output do not mean the session has root privileges.

title: Failed file deletion
caption: Removing /var/www/html/dbfuncs.php fails with Operation not permitted. This is a different name and path from /uploads/dbfunctions.php.

title: Separate cleartext login observation
caption: A login POST from 172.20.10.5 to 172.20.10.2 exposes submitted credentials over HTTP. It is not attributed to the main address pair; 200 OK does not establish authentication success.
